saw_lines: Watch buyers check the movement before the look, comparing tourbillons and automatics, then buy once and wear it for decades.
So the sale is won in the first seconds of the video, where the movement must show before the viewer scrolls.
Your 8 Google video ads all run as video, so a buyer who skips the opening seconds misses the movement. Cut shorter versions that open on the tourbillon.
ads_1: Movement first video for Google, opening on the tourbillon, never the logo.
